description: Named entities of fixed types (person, organization, location, product, event, date, money, law, technology), each found verbatim in your text. Returns { entities: [{ text, type }], counts }: up to 50 entities, each present in the (redacted) text, and a count per type. Price: 10 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

text.description: Text to analyse, 1 to 8,000 characters. Emails, phone numbers, card numbers, SINs and IPv4s are redacted first.

types.description: Entity types to return; default all nine.

name: entity-extract
title: Entity extraction
